title: The base change of the sheaf with exact support is an isomorphism exactly when the corresponding base change map is

difficulty_reason: In the situation of the surrounding discussion, the lemma asserts that the map of equation labelled equation-base-change-exact-support is an isomorphism if and only if the base change map Lf^*RSheafHom_{O_X}(O_Z, K) -> RSheafHom_{O_X'}(O_Z', Lf^*K) of Cohomology, Remark labelled cohomology-remark-prepare-fancy-base-change is an isomorphism (statement lines 2560-2592). The statement makes sense because O_Z' = Lf^*O_Z by the assumed Tor independence (proof lines 2594-2597). Since i'_* is exact and faithful it suffices to test the map after applying Ri'_*, and since Ri'_* o Lg^* = Lf^* o Ri_* by the Tor independence and Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-compare-base-change-closed-immersion, one obtains a map Lf^*Ri_*RSheafHom(O_Z, K) -> Ri'_*RSheafHom(O_Z', Lf^*K) whose source and target are the objects of the statement by Lemma labelled lemma-sheaf-with-exact-support-ext (proof lines 2599-2610). The proof closes by stating that the verification that this is the same map as the one constructed in the cited remark is omitted (proof lines 2610-2612). Reducing the comparison of the two base change maps to a computation after an exact faithful pushforward is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2; the omitted identification is recorded verbatim in the notes.
